issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

displayAll.description: If true, ignore #displayRows and show all loaded rows.

maxStrSoft.description:
The length after shortening strings that exceed #maxStrHard.

@see DataGrid.FormatSpec#maxStrSoft

maxStrHard.description:
Strings that exceed this length will be shortened to #maxStrSoft.

@see DataGrid.FormatSpec#maxStrHard

numberDigits.description:
The number of significant/fraction digits to format decimal numbers.

@see DataGrid.FormatSpec#numberDigits

numberStyle.description:
The style of number formatting.

@see DataGrid.FormatSpec#numberStyle

tableLoose.description:
If true, more whitespace is added in the grid. This makes it easier to read, but reduces the amount of data
visible at one time.

numberColorMap.description:
Specify a color map to be used for numeric values. This should be a sequential, diverging or cyclic color map.

@see DataGrid.HtmlSpec#numberColorMap

stringColorMap.description:
Specify a color map to be used for low-cardinality string values. This should be a qualitiative color map.

@see DataGrid.HtmlSpec#stringColorMap

noTypeListener.description: If true, the console will _not_ listen for changes to the type definitions and automatically reload them.

showTypeInSite.description: Whether the results of `c3ShowType` appear in the documentation micro-site instead of in the same tab.

showTypePrivate.description:
Whether private fields should be included in `c3ShowType` when in same tab.

@see #showTypeInSite

showTypeExpanded.description:
Whether accordions are expanded by default or all start collapsed.

@see #showTypeInSite

statusInterval.description:
How frequently to poll the server for CPU and memory usage. Set to null or non-positive to disable.

@see Jvm

theme.description:
Which color theme to use for the console. 'auto' will adapt to the user preference while 'light' and 'dark' will
select those themes explicitly.

treeDeepExpand.description:
If true, single-click on the expand button in a tree will fully expand sub-trees. When false, this behavior
requires Shift-click.

cellsRunQueued.description:
If true, Notebook cells executed while an existing cell is running are queued to start once currently executing
and previously queued cells complete. Note that this setting does not affect the behavior of "run all cells" in the
toolbar (which always runs sequentially).

newNotebookTabs.description: Tab reuse behavior for every notebook opened.

newGridTabs.description: Tab reuse behavior for every `c3Grid` displayed.

newTreeTabs.description: Tab reuse behavior for every `c3Tree` displayed.

newVizTabs.description: Tab reuse behavior for every `c3Viz` displayed.

newShowTypeTabs.description: Tab reuse behavior for every `c3ShowType` displayed.

modeWarning.description: Warning colors applied to the navigation bar for different app modes.
